viewerQuestion: Same price, different parts. What does this comparison page actually settle?
viewerTakeaway: I can apply a repeatable check to any comparison page and know when its numbers are too close to act on.

requiredCapabilities.description: Existing deterministic static Compare UI capture.

beats.narration: Three checks for any comparison page.
First, decide what would actually answer your question, before you look at any bar.
Second: every per-game gap on this page is smaller than the range the model declares for its own estimates. These are model estimates.
Third, check what the price covers. Here it is an editorial CPU-and-GPU parts subtotal, not a complete build and not a live retail price.
Open /compare and run all three checks on your own pair.
